_what: A fee screen of the journals that have actually published this paper's shape, scope-filtered to plausible homes for a fusion-junction ASO design paper.
_why: trimcrae, 2026-08-25: 'we need to find out what journals are free… just the good fits'. The shortlist and its exclusions are both written down so the filter can be argued with.
⛔_no_mandatory_APC_is_not_free: SUBSCRIPTION_OR_HYBRID means no article-processing charge, NOT $0. Nucleic Acid Therapeutics is subscription, has no APC, and charges $90 per typeset page plus colour — read at primary source 2026-08-23. Page and colour charges are per-journal, live only on author-guideline pages that 403 to the proxy and to CI alike, and appear in no structured source. Every row below carries that unknown.
⚠_these_are_databases_not_publisher_page: OpenAlex and DOAJ are bibliographic databases. They are the best machine-readable evidence available and they are not the journal's own fee page. A row is a lead to confirm in a browser before submitting, not a fee quotation.
⛔_a_wrong_identifier_answers_confidently: The first run of this screen took the first ISSN in each NLM record. Those records list related and continuing titles too, so Nucleic Acids Research resolved to 0261-3166 — a different journal — and the screen reported 'no mandatory APC' for a fully open-access journal that charges one. Rows are now keyed on ISSNLinking and accepted only when MedlineTA matches the abbreviation exactly; anything unmatched is UNRESOLVED rather than defaulted.

excluded_from_the_shortlist.bioRxiv: a preprint server, not a journal — and it declined this author as unaffiliated
excluded_from_the_shortlist.Res Sq: a preprint server, not a journal
excluded_from_the_shortlist.Methods Mol Biol: a protocols book series, not a journal taking primary research
excluded_from_the_shortlist.Nature: no realistic path for a single-author, wet-lab-free rare-disease design paper
excluded_from_the_shortlist.Proc Natl Acad Sci U S A: same tier judgement; also needs a member communicator route
excluded_from_the_shortlist.J Clin Invest: same tier judgement, and it wants clinical or in-vivo data
excluded_from_the_shortlist.J Am Chem Soc: same tier judgement, and the framing is not chemical
excluded_from_the_shortlist.Angew Chem Int Ed Engl: same tier judgement, and the framing is not chemical
excluded_from_the_shortlist.Am J Hum Genet: human genetics; this paper reports no new genetic observation
excluded_from_the_shortlist.Dev Biol: developmental biology; its ASO papers are morpholinos in embryos
excluded_from_the_shortlist.J Neurochem: the ASO literature here is neurological, wrong disease scope
excluded_from_the_shortlist.J Cell Mol Med: broad but its census hits are not design work
excluded_from_the_shortlist.CPT Pharmacometrics Syst Pharmacol: pharmacokinetic modelling, a different kind of dry paper
excluded_from_the_shortlist.J Biol Chem: moved to full open access with a mandatory APC; excluded on fee, not scope
excluded_from_the_shortlist.J Biomol Struct Dyn: structure-simulation journal; the paper models no structure
